verdict.rationale: turbopuffer documents BM25 full-text search, dense and sparse vector search, multi-queries explicitly meant for hybrid search, and server-side rank fusion via RRF plus native reranking. Together these deliver dense plus keyword/sparse retrieval fused into one ranked result. Missing for 10: detail on fusion configuration (e.g., weighting or methods beyond RRF) and independent or hands-on corroboration of hybrid query quality.
